annotations.title: Calculate Korea reduced hours childcare pay

description: Korean reduced working hours for childcare benefit (육아기 근로시간 단축 급여) for 2026: child aged 12 or under (grade 6 or lower), hours after reduction 15-35 per week. First 10 weekly hours cut: monthly ordinary wage (base capped 2.5M, floor 0.5M KRW) × cut ÷ hours before; hours beyond 10: 80% of ordinary wage (cap 1.6M, floor 0.5M) × cut ÷ hours before (고용보험법 시행령 제104조의2). Returns the insurance benefit, the employer's reduced pay, the monthly total and the remaining loss.

afterHours.description: Weekly contracted hours after the reduction (15-35)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage on the start date (KRW)
